description: Fetch one agent run: its run record, metric series (CPU/mem/disk over time), and the agent session summaries (role, outcome, cost, sessionId). sessions lists every session of the run's role on the mission; runSessionId names this run's own, so read its log and cost from that one.

sandboxId.description: Agent run id: the run's sandbox id, from list_agent_runs

name: get_agent_run
title: Get agent run detail
